subject: [PATCH 05/16] selftests/mm: add khugepaged completion barrier helper

2026-08-02.patch_summary: This patch adds a helper function called khugepaged_full_pass() to drive the khugepaged daemon synchronously. The function uses a completion barrier to ensure that exactly one full scan pass is completed before proceeding. This is necessary for race and functional tests, which need to set up a layout, let one full scan pass complete, and then check the result. The patch also updates the khugepaged selftest to use this new helper function and ensures that settings pushes and pops do not start unnecessary scan passes.
